_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Mathematics Standard (041), set 30/3/2. 23 pages: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions; English on every even index 2-22, Hindi on every odd index (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi, and every English page opens on a fresh question with the previous English page ending on a complete one, so nothing overflows; last page idx 22 English. Instruction (viii) prints 2 internal choices in B, 2 in C, 2 in D and 3 in E: Q21, Q23, Q30, Q31, Q32, Q35, Q36, Q37, Q38, all found on the paper and in the scheme. Section-A keys read off the marking scheme for 30/3/2 and each re-derived: all agree; no void notes. Decimal points are RAISED (Q28, Q33). Sibling of 30/3/1: 40 rows carry the reference's stem, context, options, answer and filing byte-for-byte after a read of this paper's page; 13 rows (Q5, Q6, Q7, Q13, Q14, Q15, Q21a, Q21b, Q26, Q27, Q32a, Q32b, Q34) are new to this set. The three case studies are 30/3/1's, reordered (IMD rainfall is Case Study 1 here, the garden 2, the lighthouse 3); Q19 and Q20 swap their Assertion-Reason pair.

questions.context: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.
questions.stem:
**Assertion (A) :** If two tangents are drawn to a circle from an external point, then they subtend equal angles at the centre of the circle.

**Reason (R) :** A parallelogram circumscribing a circle is a rhombus.

options.label: A
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: B
options.text: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is **not** the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).

options.label: C
options.text: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

options.label: D
options.text: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
